maren.note: Ancient village elder. Foul-mouthed, warm, zero patience.

nyla.note: Healer. Brisk, dry, mothers you while insulting you.

bram.note: Guard captain. Loud, gravelly, aggressively enthusiastic.

pip.note: Excitable kid. Fast, breathless, delighted with himself.

755bff4a8e9e4870.speaker: maren
755bff4a8e9e4870.text: Oh good, another wandering jackass with a sword. Welcome to Brindlemere. I am Maren, elder of this valley, which means I am old as balls and nobody listens to me.
755bff4a8e9e4870.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[dry, unimpressed] Oh good, another wandering jackass with a sword. Welcome to Brindlemere. I am Maren, elder of this valley, which means I am old as balls and nobody listens to me.

315ba9f75ff5c6bd.speaker: maren
315ba9f75ff5c6bd.text: Seventy years ago a star exploded over the northern sky and took a flaming dump all over the Elderwood. Prettiest damn catastrophe I ever saw.
315ba9f75ff5c6bd.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] Seventy years ago a star exploded over the northern sky and took a flaming dump all over the Elderwood. Prettiest damn catastrophe I ever saw.

11af51fba9c19591.speaker: maren
11af51fba9c19591.text: Where it landed, the old shrine — the Hollow Shrine — slammed itself shut like an outhouse door in a windstorm. And ever since, the boglins have been breeding like drunk rabbits.
11af51fba9c19591.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] Where it landed, the old shrine — the Hollow Shrine — slammed itself shut like an outhouse door in a windstorm. And ever since, the boglins have been breeding like drunk rabbits.

6a85dac854ddc272.speaker: maren
6a85dac854ddc272.text: The Hollow Shrine is older than any kingdom, older than my knees, and my knees are ancient pieces of shit. Legend says a blade sleeps inside — the Sunblade, forged from the first dawn.
6a85dac854ddc272.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] The Hollow Shrine is older than any kingdom, older than my knees, and my knees are ancient pieces of shit. Legend says a blade sleeps inside — the Sunblade, forged from the first dawn.

230a21820e8a3398.speaker: maren
230a21820e8a3398.text: When the star fell, the shrine drank its light and locked its doors. Whatever woke up in there has been gnawing at the seal ever since. Probably horny, definitely angry. That is usually how it goes.
230a21820e8a3398.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] When the star fell, the shrine drank its light and locked its doors. Whatever woke up in there has been gnawing at the seal ever since. Probably horny, definitely angry. That is usually how it goes.

222b99e007f160fa.speaker: maren
222b99e007f160fa.text: You carry a sword and you have not tripped over anything since you got here, which puts you ahead of every young man in this village.
222b99e007f160fa.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] You carry a sword and you have not tripped over anything since you got here, which puts you ahead of every young man in this village.

391f26c3805148c9.speaker: maren
391f26c3805148c9.text: Haul your shapely ass north through the Elderwood to the Hollow Shrine. Kick the door in, stab whatever screeches at you, and grab the Sunblade.
391f26c3805148c9.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] Haul your shapely ass north through the Elderwood to the Hollow Shrine. Kick the door in, stab whatever screeches at you, and grab the Sunblade.

44ad324cfebb0046.speaker: maren
44ad324cfebb0046.text: Do this, and Brindlemere will owe you everything. Which, fair warning, is mostly stew and compliments.
44ad324cfebb0046.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] Do this, and Brindlemere will owe you everything. Which, fair warning, is mostly stew and compliments.

a5a5328beee6d4e1.speaker: maren
a5a5328beee6d4e1.text: Hot damn, an actual volunteer! Follow the north road past the standing stones and keep the peaks on your right. If you end up in the lake, you went wrong somewhere and frankly deserve it.
a5a5328beee6d4e1.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gleeful] Hot damn, an actual volunteer! Follow the north road past the standing stones and keep the peaks on your right. If you end up in the lake, you went wrong somewhere and frankly deserve it.

da16029aad615090.speaker: maren
da16029aad615090.text: Rest here whenever you must — the village will patch your wounds and judge your life choices free of charge. Now piss off heroically.
da16029aad615090.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gleeful] Rest here whenever you must — the village will patch your wounds and judge your life choices free of charge. Now piss off heroically.

40ea4a29a56f4653.speaker: maren
40ea4a29a56f4653.text: Smart. Dead heroes are just expensive fertilizer. Talk to Captain Bram — angry little man, cannot miss him — and Nyla if you need medicine. The shrine has waited seventy years; it can wait for you to get your shit together.
40ea4a29a56f4653.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] Smart. Dead heroes are just expensive fertilizer. Talk to Captain Bram — angry little man, cannot miss him — and Nyla if you need medicine. The shrine has waited seventy years; it can wait for you to get your shit together.

008041eef5aeafd4.speaker: maren
008041eef5aeafd4.text: The shrine is STILL north, sweetheart. Past the Elderwood, carved doorway in the rock, big amber sigil. It is not subtle. Neither am I.
008041eef5aeafd4.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] The shrine is STILL north, sweetheart. Past the Elderwood, carved doorway in the rock, big amber sigil. It is not subtle. Neither am I.

7dd73271f4d18dab.speaker: maren
7dd73271f4d18dab.text: Go stab the scary thing and come back in one piece. I am too old to sew anyone back together.
7dd73271f4d18dab.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gruff but fond] Go stab the scary thing and come back in one piece. I am too old to sew anyone back together.

313ddd490108df23.speaker: maren
313ddd490108df23.text: Well butter my ass and call me a biscuit — the Sunblade! You actually did it! Seventy years of doom and gloom, fixed by some lunatic who walked in off the road!
313ddd490108df23.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[overjoyed, cackling] Well butter my ass and call me a biscuit — the Sunblade! You actually did it! Seventy years of doom and gloom, fixed by some lunatic who walked in off the road!

725067b02758320a.speaker: maren
725067b02758320a.text: The valley breathes easier tonight, traveller. You did what no army could, mostly because no army ever bothered to show up.
725067b02758320a.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] The valley breathes easier tonight, traveller. You did what no army could, mostly because no army ever bothered to show up.

38684645bee83eff.speaker: maren
38684645bee83eff.text: Take this blessing. It is the least Brindlemere owes you, and believe me, this village always pays the least it owes.
38684645bee83eff.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] Take this blessing. It is the least Brindlemere owes you, and believe me, this village always pays the least it owes.

633ffaf19dea2dbb.speaker: maren
633ffaf19dea2dbb.text: Every lantern in Brindlemere burns brighter since you got back. Now sit down and eat some stew before you fall over. Heroes are still idiots on an empty stomach.
633ffaf19dea2dbb.renderKey: eleven_v3|XrExE9yKIg1WjnnlVkGX|{"stability":0.28,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.65}|[gravelly, cackling] Every lantern in Brindlemere burns brighter since you got back. Now sit down and eat some stew before you fall over. Heroes are still idiots on an empty stomach.

db353266f54507dc.speaker: nyla
db353266f54507dc.text: Watch the doorway — drying herbs everywhere, and if you knock down my wolfsbane I will heal you and THEN kill you. I am Nyla. Scrapes, fevers and broken hearts mended, in that order, cash up front.
db353266f54507dc.renderKey: eleven_v3|Xb7hH8MSUJpSbSDYk0k2|{"stability":0.34,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.55}|[cheerfully menacing] Watch the doorway — drying herbs everywhere, and if you knock down my wolfsbane I will heal you and THEN kill you. I am Nyla. Scrapes, fevers and broken hearts mended, in that order, cash up front.

d39656bb5acd8551.speaker: nyla
d39656bb5acd8551.text: My potion stores are drier than a lizard’s armpit. The good glowshrooms only grow in the Elderwood shade, and I am not going in there — the last thing that skittered at me had way too many legs and zero respect.
d39656bb5acd8551.renderKey: eleven_v3|Xb7hH8MSUJpSbSDYk0k2|{"stability":0.34,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.55}|[brisk, sardonic] My potion stores are drier than a lizard’s armpit. The good glowshrooms only grow in the Elderwood shade, and I am not going in there — the last thing that skittered at me had way too many legs and zero respect.

61103f39ba9e6673.speaker: nyla
61103f39ba9e6673.text: Oh, bless your reckless little heart. Five glowshrooms — the blue glowing caps under the old trees. And yes, before you ask, people HAVE tried licking them. Those people now speak exclusively to furniture.
61103f39ba9e6673.renderKey: eleven_v3|Xb7hH8MSUJpSbSDYk0k2|{"stability":0.34,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.55}|[deadpan] Oh, bless your reckless little heart. Five glowshrooms — the blue glowing caps under the old trees. And yes, before you ask, people HAVE tried licking them. Those people now speak exclusively to furniture.

072d2385ef4f680f.speaker: nyla
072d2385ef4f680f.text: Bring the shrooms back un-licked and I will brew you something worth the walk.
072d2385ef4f680f.renderKey: eleven_v3|Xb7hH8MSUJpSbSDYk0k2|{"stability":0.34,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.55}|[brisk, sardonic] Bring the shrooms back un-licked and I will brew you something worth the walk.

58c5930ce8e395d6.speaker: nyla
58c5930ce8e395d6.text: Sleep with your boots on, never trust anything with more eyes than you, and do not swim on an empty stamina wheel unless drowning like a dumbass is on your bucket list. That last one is not a joke. I have pulled three heroes out of that lake. Two were grateful.
58c5930ce8e395d6.renderKey: eleven_v3|Xb7hH8MSUJpSbSDYk0k2|{"stability":0.34,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.55}|[brisk, sardonic] Sleep with your boots on, never trust anything with more eyes than you, and do not swim on an empty stamina wheel unless drowning like a dumbass is on your bucket list. That last one is not a joke. I have pulled three heroes out of that lake. Two were grateful.

cf1f6ae372382019.speaker: nyla
cf1f6ae372382019.text: Perfect caps, every damn one. Give me a breath… aaand there. Two restoratives, and coin for your trouble. Do not chug them both at once, you absolute animal.
cf1f6ae372382019.renderKey: eleven_v3|Xb7hH8MSUJpSbSDYk0k2|{"stability":0.34,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.55}|[brisk, sardonic] Perfect caps, every damn one. Give me a breath… aaand there. Two restoratives, and coin for your trouble. Do not chug them both at once, you absolute animal.

a3b3550704ecd68d.speaker: nyla
a3b3550704ecd68d.text: Drink them when the hearts run low — inventory, then use. Even heroes forget, because heroes, as a rule, are gorgeous and stupid.
a3b3550704ecd68d.renderKey: eleven_v3|Xb7hH8MSUJpSbSDYk0k2|{"stability":0.34,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.55}|[brisk, sardonic] Drink them when the hearts run low — inventory, then use. Even heroes forget, because heroes, as a rule, are gorgeous and stupid.

61a4c52d3854d407.speaker: nyla
61a4c52d3854d407.text: My shelves glow again, thanks to you. If the wilds chew on you, come straight here. If a boglin chews on you somewhere embarrassing, come here anyway — I have seen worse and I WILL laugh.
61a4c52d3854d407.renderKey: eleven_v3|Xb7hH8MSUJpSbSDYk0k2|{"stability":0.34,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.55}|[brisk, sardonic] My shelves glow again, thanks to you. If the wilds chew on you, come straight here. If a boglin chews on you somewhere embarrassing, come here anyway — I have seen worse and I WILL laugh.

a149c792479fa698.speaker: bram
a149c792479fa698.text: Hold there — sword arm up, let us see… huh. You hold that thing like you have actually killed something. Around here that makes you a goddamn war hero. I am Bram, captain of a guard that consists of me and a bell.
a149c792479fa698.renderKey: eleven_v3|N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO|{"stability":0.25,"similarity_boost":0.8,"style":0.75}|[booming, gruff] Hold there — sword arm up, let us see… huh. You hold that thing like you have actually killed something. Around here that makes you a goddamn war hero. I am Bram, captain of a guard that consists of me and a bell.

0a193a2d7f79de37.speaker: bram
0a193a2d7f79de37.text: Boglin camps are creeping closer every moon. Five camps ring this valley now, the cocky little shits, and last week one of them mooned me. MOONED me. A captain of the guard.
0a193a2d7f79de37.renderKey: eleven_v3|N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO|{"stability":0.25,"similarity_boost":0.8,"style":0.75}|[outraged] Boglin camps are creeping closer every moon. Five camps ring this valley now, the cocky little shits, and last week one of them mooned me. MOONED me. A captain of the guard.

144654cc9e4ea026.speaker: bram
144654cc9e4ea026.text: HA! Music to my ears. Put down ten of the wretches — that should teach the rest to keep their pants up and their distance.
144654cc9e4ea026.renderKey: eleven_v3|N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO|{"stability":0.25,"similarity_boost":0.8,"style":0.75}|[barking a laugh] HA! Music to my ears. Put down ten of the wretches — that should teach the rest to keep their pants up and their distance.

bfa95ba981bf1963.speaker: bram
bfa95ba981bf1963.text: Watch the big horned ones. When a brute raises that club, you ROLL. Do not block. Blocking a brute is how you become a smear with a sword. ROLL, damn you.
bfa95ba981bf1963.renderKey: eleven_v3|N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO|{"stability":0.25,"similarity_boost":0.8,"style":0.75}|[shouting] Watch the big horned ones. When a brute raises that club, you ROLL. Do not block. Blocking a brute is how you become a smear with a sword. ROLL, damn you.

ec52d9a6ee6b7dac.speaker: bram
ec52d9a6ee6b7dac.text: Three lessons, free, because I am bored out of my skull. One: the third swing hits like a divorce — finish your combos.
ec52d9a6ee6b7dac.renderKey: eleven_v3|N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO|{"stability":0.25,"similarity_boost":0.8,"style":0.75}|[booming, gruff] Three lessons, free, because I am bored out of my skull. One: the third swing hits like a divorce — finish your combos.

c3c0c93dc2786f97.speaker: bram
c3c0c93dc2786f97.text: Two: hold your swing after the first cut and release to spin. Clears a crowd like a fart in a bathhouse.
c3c0c93dc2786f97.renderKey: eleven_v3|N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO|{"stability":0.25,"similarity_boost":0.8,"style":0.75}|[gleeful] Two: hold your swing after the first cut and release to spin. Clears a crowd like a fart in a bathhouse.

a53ee9c95f31acf3.speaker: bram
a53ee9c95f31acf3.text: Three: lock on. Tab, or click the stick. A guard who circles wins the fight. A guard who stands still gets a club suppository.
a53ee9c95f31acf3.renderKey: eleven_v3|N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO|{"stability":0.25,"similarity_boost":0.8,"style":0.75}|[gleeful] Three: lock on. Tab, or click the stick. A guard who circles wins the fight. A guard who stands still gets a club suppository.

253f2e37f0cd8dcd.speaker: bram
253f2e37f0cd8dcd.text: Outstanding work, soldier. Here — guard pay, plus a breathing trick I learned from a monk I arm-wrestled. Long story. He cheated. So did I.
253f2e37f0cd8dcd.renderKey: eleven_v3|N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO|{"stability":0.25,"similarity_boost":0.8,"style":0.75}|[booming, gruff] Outstanding work, soldier. Here — guard pay, plus a breathing trick I learned from a monk I arm-wrestled. Long story. He cheated. So did I.

d71370738a2988b9.speaker: bram
d71370738a2988b9.text: Deeper breaths, longer sprints. Now get out of here before I salute you and embarrass us both.
d71370738a2988b9.renderKey: eleven_v3|N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO|{"stability":0.25,"similarity_boost":0.8,"style":0.75}|[booming, gruff] Deeper breaths, longer sprints. Now get out of here before I salute you and embarrass us both.

8661fc9e0ea2c044.speaker: bram
8661fc9e0ea2c044.text: The watchfires burn quiet lately. Your doing. If you ever want honest work, the guard pays like crap and the bell needs polishing, but the company is outstanding. It is me. I am the company.
8661fc9e0ea2c044.renderKey: eleven_v3|N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO|{"stability":0.25,"similarity_boost":0.8,"style":0.75}|[booming, gruff] The watchfires burn quiet lately. Your doing. If you ever want honest work, the guard pays like crap and the bell needs polishing, but the company is outstanding. It is me. I am the company.

9964d0beb208d804.speaker: tam
9964d0beb208d804.text: Welcome, welcome! Tam’s Sundries — finest stall between the lake and the peaks, on account of being the only one. Competition is for suckers and towns with more than six people.
9964d0beb208d804.renderKey: eleven_v3|JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb|{"stability":0.35,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.6}|[warm, oily] Welcome, welcome! Tam’s Sundries — finest stall between the lake and the peaks, on account of being the only one. Competition is for suckers and towns with more than six people.

861258346ae43f0e.speaker: tam
861258346ae43f0e.text: What will it be? And no, the prices are not negotiable. I have a monopoly and a complete lack of shame.
861258346ae43f0e.renderKey: eleven_v3|JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb|{"stability":0.35,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.6}|[shameless pride] What will it be? And no, the prices are not negotiable. I have a monopoly and a complete lack of shame.

77fc2bf16b7f87fb.speaker: tam
77fc2bf16b7f87fb.text: Pleasure doing business! Drink it when the hearts run low, and if it tastes like feet — that is normal. That is how you know it is working.
77fc2bf16b7f87fb.renderKey: eleven_v3|JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb|{"stability":0.35,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.6}|[breezy] Pleasure doing business! Drink it when the hearts run low, and if it tastes like feet — that is normal. That is how you know it is working.

2f5137a8349cdc12.speaker: tam
2f5137a8349cdc12.text: Broke, eh? No shame in it — well, some shame. Gems: green ones, blue worth five, red worth twenty. Boglins hoard them because boglins are tiny greedy bastards, and chests hide them. Come back jingling!
2f5137a8349cdc12.renderKey: eleven_v3|JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb|{"stability":0.35,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.6}|[warm, oily] Broke, eh? No shame in it — well, some shame. Gems: green ones, blue worth five, red worth twenty. Boglins hoard them because boglins are tiny greedy bastards, and chests hide them. Come back jingling!

86808ced4c5c7947.speaker: tam
86808ced4c5c7947.text: Crack open a boglin camp or a chest and they pour out like rain. The ruins east of the wood are said to hold a fat one. You did not hear that from me, because technically telling you counts as "looting advice" and my permit is… let us say "aspirational."
86808ced4c5c7947.renderKey: eleven_v3|JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb|{"stability":0.35,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.6}|[conspiratorial] Crack open a boglin camp or a chest and they pour out like rain. The ruins east of the wood are said to hold a fat one. You did not hear that from me, because technically telling you counts as "looting advice" and my permit is… let us say "aspirational."

da650abd19a8b247.speaker: pip
da650abd19a8b247.text: Psst! Traveller! Wanna hear a secret? I know ALL the secrets. Even the ones mum says will get my mouth washed out.
da650abd19a8b247.renderKey: eleven_v3|cgSgspJ2msm6clMCkdW9|{"stability":0.2,"similarity_boost":0.7,"style":0.85}|[breathless child] Psst! Traveller! Wanna hear a secret? I know ALL the secrets. Even the ones mum says will get my mouth washed out.

6b1416d8e04768b2.speaker: pip
6b1416d8e04768b2.text: The old standing stones east of the woods? If you climb the hill at night, the tops glow a tiny bit. Farmer Rho says it is moss. Rho is FULL OF CRAP. That is swearing but mum is not here so.
6b1416d8e04768b2.renderKey: eleven_v3|cgSgspJ2msm6clMCkdW9|{"stability":0.2,"similarity_boost":0.7,"style":0.85}|[gleeful whisper] The old standing stones east of the woods? If you climb the hill at night, the tops glow a tiny bit. Farmer Rho says it is moss. Rho is FULL OF CRAP. That is swearing but mum is not here so.

fe71b31d419c2fc7.speaker: pip
fe71b31d419c2fc7.text: Also there is a chest up there. I am too small to open it. You are not! You are HUGE. Like a brute but with better teeth!
fe71b31d419c2fc7.renderKey: eleven_v3|cgSgspJ2msm6clMCkdW9|{"stability":0.2,"similarity_boost":0.7,"style":0.85}|[breathless child] Also there is a chest up there. I am too small to open it. You are not! You are HUGE. Like a brute but with better teeth!

c714a9e3f824ad69.speaker: pip
c714a9e3f824ad69.text: Down by Mirrowmere, way out along the far shore, I saw a chest half-buried in the sand! But the deep water is scary and mum says I will be eaten butt-first.
c714a9e3f824ad69.renderKey: eleven_v3|cgSgspJ2msm6clMCkdW9|{"stability":0.2,"similarity_boost":0.7,"style":0.85}|[breathless child] Down by Mirrowmere, way out along the far shore, I saw a chest half-buried in the sand! But the deep water is scary and mum says I will be eaten butt-first.

690966f2e637c7d8.speaker: pip
690966f2e637c7d8.text: If you find gems in it I get ten percent. That is the RULE of secrets. I did not make the rule but I enforce the hell out of it. THAT one does not count as swearing, Bram says it constantly.
690966f2e637c7d8.renderKey: eleven_v3|cgSgspJ2msm6clMCkdW9|{"stability":0.2,"similarity_boost":0.7,"style":0.85}|[very serious] If you find gems in it I get ten percent. That is the RULE of secrets. I did not make the rule but I enforce the hell out of it. THAT one does not count as swearing, Bram says it constantly.

5df8abc9026bf693.speaker: rho
5df8abc9026bf693.text: Grass is good this season. Rain when we need it, sun when we do not. Only things spoiling the view are boglin smoke on the ridges and Bram doing shirtless "patrols" past the widow Hettle’s fence. Nobody is fooled, Bram.
5df8abc9026bf693.renderKey: eleven_v3|pqHfZKP75CvOlQylNhV4|{"stability":0.45,"similarity_boost":0.75,"style":0.4}|[dry, scandalized] Grass is good this season. ffd592feda638994.text: Aye — wisps. Pale cold lights drifting over the fields once the sun is well down. Pretty, until one spits fire at you. Lost half a haystack and most of my dignity running from one last week.

7dc47cddcff2ca77.speaker: rho
7dc47cddcff2ca77.text: They fade at dawn like dew. If one takes to hissing at you, put steel through the glowing bit and do not write a ballad about it. Looking at you, every bard ever.
